title: Eval harness: fixtures, objective grader and benchmark layout
description: evals/evals.json schema per the siblings, fixture repositories with a known source of truth, evals/grade.py that re-derives the truth (parses, node cap, accessibility fields, every node in the source, explanation present), and the iteration-N benchmark layout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: evals/grade.py grades a run directory into grading.json with text/passed/evidence expectations, without trusting the agent claims
Each fixture declares its source of truth as data the grader reads
pytest covers the grader on a known-good and a known-bad output

implementationNotes: grade.py proven both ways per kind (architecture, states, sequence, decision, plan, ER, review, fix) on hand-written good/bad answers; tests/test_grade.py covers good/bad cases (27 tests pass). Iteration-1 run: 24 runs, with skill 77/77, without 60/77; benchmark in evals/benchmarks/iteration-1. Grader fixed twice mid-round (node classification; quoted labels with parentheses), applied to both arms before final grading. flow_edges moved into diagram_lint so the grader depends only on landed engine code.
finalSummary: Eval harness: evals/evals.json (12 cases, machine-readable truth), evals/fixtures/shop + review-docs, evals/setup_ws.sh (builds a Quest tracker via the CLI), evals/grade.py (objective, convention-neutral), tests/test_grade.py, and iteration-1 benchmark (with skill 100%, without 78%, +0.22).
